mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND VALID_FLAG = '1' AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY ITEM_NO ASC, ID ASC

SELECT ID, ITEM_NO, MASTER_RECORD_ID, RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID, CHANGE_TYPE, BEFORE_STATUS, TARGET_STATUS, CURRENT_VERSION_NO, TARGET_VERSION_NO, BEFORE_DATA, PROPOSED_DATA, EXECUTE_STATUS, EXECUTE_MESSAGE FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND VALID_FLAG = '1' AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY ITEM_NO ASC, ID ASC

SELECT ID, ITEM_NO, MASTER_RECORD_ID, RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID, CHANGE_TYPE, BEFORE_STATUS, TARGET_STATUS, CURRENT_VERSION_NO, TARGET_VERSION_NO, BEFORE_DATA, PROPOSED_DATA, EXECUTE_STATUS, EXECUTE_MESSAGE FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND (MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId} OR RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId}) AND VALID_FLAG = '1' AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY ITEM_NO ASC, ID ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM i INNER JOIN MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r ON r.ID = i.REQUEST_ID WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND i.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND i.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND COALESCE(i.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID, i.MASTER_RECORD_ID) = #{masterRecordId}

SELECT approval_ranked.RECORD_ID FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(i.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID, i.MASTER_RECORD_ID) AS RECORD_ID, r.STATUS AS APPROVAL_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(i.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID, i.MASTER_RECORD_ID) ORDER BY CASE WHEN THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.SUBMIT_TIME DESC, r.ID DESC ) AS RN FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM i INNER JOIN MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r ON r.ID = i.REQUEST_ID WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND i.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND i.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) approval_ranked WHERE approval_ranked.RN = 1 AND approval_ranked.APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}

SELECT i.ID AS ITEM_ID, i.CHANGE_TYPE, i.BEFORE_STATUS, i.TARGET_STATUS, i.EXECUTE_TIME, q.APPLICANT_ID, q.REQUEST_NO, q.APPLY_REASON, q.STATUS AS APPROVAL_STATUS FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM i INNER JOIN MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST q ON q.ID = i.REQUEST_ID WHERE q.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND i.MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterDataId} AND q.CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND q.STATUS = '1' AND q.EXECUTE_STATUS IN ('2', '3') AND i.EXECUTE_STATUS = '2' AND i.CHANGE_TYPE IN ('FREEZE', 'UNFREEZE', 'INVALIDATE', 'RECOVER', 'ARCHIVE') AND i.BEFORE_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND i.TARGET_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND i.BEFORE_STATUS <> i.TARGET_STATUS AND q.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND q.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND i.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND i.DEL_FLAG = '0'
ORDER BY i.ID
ASC DESC
ORDER BY i.EXECUTE_TIME
ASC DESC , i.ID
ASC DESC
ORDER BY i.EXECUTE_TIME DESC, i.ID DESC
